angleRead.name: Luis Navarro
angleRead.text: The Baylight District final council vote has been sitting in a construction-active state for three cycles now, and I've been watching the delay like I watch a runner held at third with nobody out. Something's not lining up. The mayor's office is publishing audits and outcome reports, the council is moving other initiatives forward, and this one just sits. I've got Marcus Webb, who runs OEWD, and Leonard Tran, who holds an office touching Baylight District Remediation. Neither one has given me a public answer on what's holding the vote. I'm not going to invent a scandal where one might not exist — maybe the construction work genuinely needs to finish first, maybe there's a legitimate procedur
